notes: Metadata API: /sources/2/series/{codes}/metadata accepts semicolon-joined series codes (one call for all 4). Object envelope; per_page is quoted '5000'; total counts metatype entries (60), not series. Metatype set varies per series (14-16 keys): e.g. NY.GDP.PCAP.CD lacks Limitationsandexceptions; only SP.POP.TOTL has Othernotes. Includes License_Type 'CC BY-4.0', License_URL, Unitofmeasure, Aggregationmethod, Periodicity, Referenceperiod.
